risk_definition: 1R is the full fixed stake at risk. stop_price 0 means no mechanical downside stop; exit into a favorable swing.

plays.title: Spain to beat Argentina in regulation
plays.thesis: BUY-ONLY reversible-dip fade: Spain is the higher-quality pregame side, but 43c is efficient. Buy only after an early Argentina goal creates a stabilized discount near 35% of the pregame ask.
plays.entry_condition: Argentina scores by 25:00; Spain remains tactically intact; selling exhausts and the tape forms a higher low or Spain renews pressure; executable YES ask is 0.15 or lower.
plays.invalidation: No entry after 25:00, after a red card or material injury, during a continuing fall, or if Argentina is structurally controlling the match.
plays.exit_rule: Exit into the live comeback payoff; 0.45 is the 2R target cap, not a requirement to hold to resolution.
plays.resolves_at_note: Expected shortly after regulation; exchange settlement may be later.

plays.title: Boston Red Sox to beat Tampa Bay Rays
plays.thesis: Immutable live-discount setup: Boston has the stronger immediate form and Sonny Gray matchup, but there is no pregame edge at 54c. A reversible early deficit at 19c offers the quality outcome at 35% of its pregame ask.
plays.entry_condition: Before the seventh inning; Boston trails by no more than three runs; Gray is active; game and tape show a rally, higher low, or selling exhaustion; executable YES ask is 0.19 or lower.
plays.invalidation: No entry on a starter scratch, material weather change, deficit greater than three, seventh inning or later, continuing free fall, or structural contact/velocity damage.
plays.exit_rule: Exit into the comeback repricing; target 0.57 equals 2R from the maximum entry.
plays.resolves_at_note: Expected game-resolution window; delays and settlement can move this time.

plays.title: Dplus KIA to beat Karmine Corp
plays.thesis: Quality-side series fade: DK is about a 70% pregame outcome, so 71c is a favorite chase. A stabilized 22c panic print while the series remains recoverable is the required Buffett-grade discount.
plays.entry_condition: An adverse early series state drives YES to 0.22 or lower; comeback path remains open; no roster or health issue; selloff has stopped and formed a higher low.
plays.invalidation: No entry in an unrecoverable series state, after repeated structural draft mismatch, on roster/health news, in a map-only market, or while price is still falling.
plays.exit_rule: Exit into the comeback repricing; target 0.66 equals 2R and remains below the pregame ask.
plays.resolves_at_note: Expected series-resolution window; match duration and settlement can vary.

plays.title: Argentina to beat Spain in regulation
plays.thesis: BUY-ONLY reversible-dip fade on an elite outcome. Spain's defensive quality makes ordinary cheapness a trap, so Argentina qualifies only at 10c with clear stabilization after an early concession.
plays.entry_condition: Spain scores by 25:00; Argentina remains tactically alive; selling exhausts and Argentina shows a higher low or credible attacking response; executable YES ask is 0.10 or lower.
plays.invalidation: No entry after 25:00, after a red card or material injury, during a continuing fall, or if Spain is structurally controlling the match.
plays.exit_rule: Exit into the live comeback payoff; target 0.30 equals 2R from the maximum entry.
plays.resolves_at_note: Expected shortly after regulation; exchange settlement may be later.
